# Flame v2.7.1

- Fix text color inheritance across the interface, including the Clock and Quotes descriptions and quote endpoint test results.
- Theme native form controls, placeholders and file selection buttons; remove a hard-coded notification text color.
- Update menu text colors immediately when switching themes.
- Preserve intentional accent, inverted control colors and individual clock colors.
- Add Chromium regression coverage for light and dark themes across settings and main pages.

Docker images are published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
